# VBD Upstream Notice

This directory contains a vendored subset of VBD used by ECoSim inference and
BehaviorVAE latent export. It is not a full mirror of the upstream repository.

Upstream project:

- **Versatile Behavior Diffusion for Generalized Traffic Agent Simulation**
- Paper: <https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.02524>

If you use the VBD components, please cite the upstream work:

```bibtex
@article{huang2024versatile,
  title = {Versatile Behavior Diffusion for Generalized Traffic Agent Simulation},
  author = {Huang, Zhiyu and Zhang, Zixu and Vaidya, Ameya and Chen, Yuxiao and Lv, Chen and Fisac, Jaime Fern{\'a}ndez},
  journal = {arXiv preprint arXiv:2404.02524},
  year = {2024}
}
```

For ECoSim usage, follow the repository-level README and docs instead of the
upstream VBD commands.
